segments.comment: makemon.c align_shift() caches its Is_special() lookup per svm.moves. A wizard-mode ^V teleport takes no time, so Dlvl 2 (built at moves 1, an ordinary level whose random monsters make the turn's lookup find no special level) and Medusa's level (built in the same turn) share that lookup: C weights Medusa's monsters by the unaligned main dungeon, not by the level's chaotic alignment, so its first reservoir draw is rn2(3) for the giant ant rather than rn2(5). Blocked: the recording diverges inside sp_lev.c create_object(), whose Medusa-level statue branch (makemon() of the petrified monster at a random position) is not ported. Record it once that branch lands.
